title: Russell Targ coming around to remote viewing as precognition

tellings.quote: I think Russell targ even has sort of come around to that idea

plain: Remote viewing is the claimed ability to describe faraway places or hidden targets using only the mind, and Russell Targ, a figure in that research, may have come to think it is really a kind of precognition, sensing the future, and not seeing at a distance. Eric Wargo, a writer on prophetic dreams, says this to Michels, hedging that he "think[s]" Targ "has sort of come around to that idea." If true, it would mean the same ability lies behind remote viewing and dreams that come true.
